merge_checkpoint_models: merge two or three diffusion model checkpoints from HuggingFace hub or local paths with weighted interpolation
build_merged_diffusion_pipeline: build a merged diffusion pipeline from multiple pretrained model names using sigmoid or inv_sigmoid interpolation
apply_weighted_sum_interpolation: apply weighted sum interpolation to merge model weights between two checkpoints with a given alpha value
apply_add_difference_interpolation: apply add_difference interpolation to merge three diffusion model checkpoints with alpha control
compare_model_configs: compare two model config dictionaries ignoring metadata keys starting with underscore
